text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—...Report.
Finished on the board in this race. Victory was not achieved.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The causes: insufficient training and lack of discipline.
If left unaddressed... there is a risk of declining performance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In order to take immediate action,
I request a review of the race.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best together!
I'm not going easy on you!
I'm going to be strict, okay?

Affirmative... Mode 'Straight to Victory.'
Pacing partner toward victory set to Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Let us work hand in hand to seize victory together.

Afterward, we returned to the academy...
and reviewed the race while sharing our opinions with each other!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Mode: 'Relentless.'
Whatever order you have, bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Please reforge me for the sake of victory.

Afterward, we returned to the academy...
and reviewed the race with a critical eye to improve our awareness!
